wu: Students play 'Find Someone Who...' with KET reading task prompts. Teacher hands out a grid with 'Find someone who can read a short text quickly' and 'Find someone who knows what skimming means'. Students mingle, ask questions, and mark names. They report back to the class: 'Youssef can read a short text quickly!'
wuAlt: Students play 'Quiz Quiz Trade' with KET reading terms. Each student gets a card with a term like 'skimming' or 'scanning', they quiz a partner, trade cards, and find a new partner.
Students do a 'Picture Prompt' game. Teacher shows a KET reading part 1 image, students shout out what they see in English to build vocabulary.
pres: Teacher uses a PowerPoint slide to show the KET reading part 1 format (multiple-choice matching). Teacher models skimming by reading a short text aloud quickly, then asks 'What is this text about?'. Students repeat the process with a new text. Teacher checks understanding by asking 'Do we read every word for skimming?' and students answer 'No!'.
presAlt: Teacher uses flashcards with KET reading task numbers (1, 2, 3) and describes each part: 'Part 1 is matching pictures to words'. Students repeat the task numbers and descriptions.
Teacher draws a simple KET reading part 2 (multiple-choice) on the board and explains 'We choose A, B, or C'. Students practice saying the options.
prac: Students work in pairs on a guided KET reading part 1 worksheet. Teacher circulates and helps with skimming strategies. They then play 'Reading Race' where they time each other to complete the task. Teacher gives support by highlighting key words in the text.
pracAlt: Students play 'Team Question Hunt' in groups of three. Teacher hides KET reading questions around the room. Groups race to find and answer them, writing answers on a whiteboard.
Students do 'Sentence Match-Up' with KET reading part 2. Teacher cuts up sentences and options, students work in pairs to match them correctly.
ls: Students listen to a short audio description of a KET reading part 3 (text completion). They listen and fill in the missing words on their worksheet. Teacher plays the audio twice to check real comprehension.
re: Students play 'Simon Says' with KET reading actions. Teacher says 'Simon says skim the text!' or 'Simon says scan for names!'. Students move around the room to stay active.
prod: Students work in groups of four to create their own KET reading part 1 quiz. They draw four simple pictures and write matching descriptions. Each group quizzes another group, and the class votes on the best quiz.
rw: Students complete a short KET reading part 2 (multiple-choice) text about a school trip. They read the text and choose the correct answers (A, B, or C). Then, they write two simple sentences about their own school trip using 'I went to...' or 'I saw...'.
st: Teacher tells a short, simple story about a student who prepares for a KET exam. Students listen and answer comprehension questions. Close with the goodbye routine: 'Today we learned about KET reading parts. Thank you, class!'
g: Teams race to match KET reading questions to the correct answers on the board.
Students toss a ball and name a KET reading word when they catch it.
Teacher calls out a word from the text, students find it in their books and point.
One student is the quiz master, others answer KET reading questions.
Students search a text for specific words and raise their hands when found.
diff: Fast finishers / stronger learners: Write a short paragraph about their favorite book using KET reading vocabulary.
Support / weaker learners: Use a word bank with key vocabulary from the texts to complete the reading tasks.
hw: Complete a KET reading part 1 worksheet from the KET folder.
Write three sentences about what you read today in English.
Find a short English text online (like a menu or sign) and practice skimming it.
tip: Use local Moroccan examples in the reading tasks, like a text about the Green March or a local café, to make the exam format more relatable and engaging for students.
